meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你给的技术性内容用大白话拆解,讲清它涉及的 who、what、where、why、when。

say.text: 帮我用大白话看看这份配置:到底是谁在用、是什么、在哪、为什么

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude breaks down technical material for you in plain English — covering the who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a plain-English breakdown of something technical.

say_en.text: Too technical — give me the who, what, where, why, and when in plain English
say_en.note: It breaks it down by who, what, where, why, when.

say_en.text: Break down this config in plain English: who uses it, what it is, why
say_en.note: Works with your own technical material.

say_en.text: Explain this technical term: who, what, where, why, when
say_en.note: Just name what you want broken down.
